Event & Dining Spaces

The Mezzanine Hall

✦

A beautifully carpeted, air-conditioned hall on the mezzanine level — ideal for hosting your baraat guests for shared meals during the wedding days. Book by session, independently of room reservations, to keep your celebrations seamlessly together under one roof.

🌅
Breakfast
Morning Session

Start the wedding day together. A warm, communal breakfast for all baraat guests — the perfect way to gather before the celebrations begin.

☀️
Lunch
Afternoon Session

A relaxed midday gathering for guests to rest, share a meal, and prepare for the evening's festivities. Keeping everyone refreshed and together.

🌆
Dinner
Evening Session

Bring the baraat together for a memorable evening dinner. The hall sets a gracious tone for every celebration, from welcome dinners to post-ceremony gatherings.

Why Husaini Manzil

Made for
Wedding Hospitality

✦

Husaini Manzil was shaped by one purpose: providing a dignified, comfortable, and warmly hospitable home for baraat guests. When your guests travel to Indore for your wedding, they deserve more than a hotel room — they deserve a place that feels like family.

🔒
Exclusively Yours

Book individual apartments or the entire building — your baraat gets complete privacy with no strangers sharing the space.

🏡
All Guests Under One Roof

With 16 beds across six apartments, the entire baraat party can stay together — making coordination easy and the experience joyful.

🍽
Shared Dining for the Whole Party

The Mezzanine Hall lets you host communal meals for all guests, keeping everyone together throughout the wedding days.

A Complete Wedding Stay

From the moment your baraat arrives to the final farewell, Husaini Manzil is designed to keep your guests comfortable, well-fed, and together throughout every moment of the celebration.
